title: OSLab introduction film

agent_session.prompt: Open Notepad on the Windows test VM, type "release 2.4 checked by OSLab agent" and save it to the Desktop as agent-note.txt. Then open File Explorer on the Desktop so I can see the file.

edits: Chapters 02 and 03 show one CLI run, chapter 04 a separate run that a Playwright script launched from the dashboard, and chapter 05 a separate Codex session. The opening and chapter 06 reuse the 32-VM Windows QA recordings.
Waits play faster, and each recorded chapter shows its playback speed.
The YAML and terminal panels are typeset from the scenario file and the recorded CLI output. Command typing is animated.
Local host names, user folders and private variable names are replaced in the terminal text, the HTML report and the dashboard.
The editor draws the cursors at the recorded pointer positions and interpolates the movement between them.
The 32-VM wall aligns recordings made in waves of up to 8 at each run's start, and the finished wall is held for 2 seconds.
